bootstrap.aggregate_rule: same draw index, then equal-cell mean; invalid component makes aggregate draw invalid
bootstrap.inference_boundary: source-group sampling uncertainty conditional on the frozen cells; cells, datasets, and model families are not resampled
bootstrap.shared_draws: one draw stream per cell, reused by every method and paired contrast

metric_definitions.auprc: weighted non-interpolated average precision (sklearn average_precision convention)
metric_definitions.auroc: weighted Mann-Whitney AUROC with half credit for score ties
